  const exclude = [

    ...patterns.filter((p) => p.startsWith('!')).map((p) => `${p.slice(1)}/package.json`),
evidence.reason: The current code merges positive and negated workspace patterns from both package.json and pnpm-workspace.yaml, then applies the combined exclusion list to every include glob. Thus a package.json exclusion such as !packages/cli would exclude packages/cli from the pnpm-workspace include packages/*, even though pnpm does not use package.json workspaces. That can omit a real workspace member from dependency comparison. This is an ordinary correctness defect; exclusions should be applied within each declaration's own pattern set, or the comparison should use only the workspace definition used to prepare the installed tree.
